description: Four Pillars (八字) for a birth moment: converts the clock time with the zone rules for that date (daylight saving included) and the longitude to true solar time; the year follows Li Chun and the day changes at 23:00 true solar time. Returns the pillars, Day Master, five-element counts and the time conversion details.

birth_datetime.description: Birth wall-clock time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm", as on the birth certificate.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude, east positive. Default: the standard meridian of the time zone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. "Asia/Shanghai".

name: bazi_pillars
title: BaZi Four Pillars
